# `onboard_project`

**Onboard Project.** Link, initialise or clone a repository beneath a configured root and register it.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `onboard_project` |
| Side effect | `composite` |
| Idempotency | none |
| Retry safe | no |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| `request_id` | `string` | yes | — | Idempotency key; replaying it returns the prior result |

| `repo_url` | `string` | no | — | init only: adopt an existing empty GitHub remote |

| `github_repository` | `object` | no | — | github_clone only: {owner, name} selected through search_github_repositories (exactly one of github_repository / github_url) |
